List ideas in the backlog that haven't been refined into beads yet.

Examples:
  gromit backlog              # List all ideas
  gromit backlog --type bug   # Filter by type
  gromit backlog --recent 7   # Ideas from last 7 days
  gromit backlog delete <id>  # Remove an idea

Usage:
  gromit backlog [flags]
  gromit backlog [command]

Available Commands:
  delete      Delete an idea from the backlog

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for backlog
      --recent int    Show only ideas from last N days
      --type string   Filter by type (feature, bug, chore)

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   Path to config file (default "gromit.yaml")

Use "gromit backlog [command] --help" for more information about a command.
